_read_me: Fill this in as facts arrive, then run: node build-toy-drive.mjs. Anything left null or empty renders as an amber [BRACKET] so an unfinished image can't pass for a finished one.
vaa_written_ok_note: Set true only once VAA's email saying Surge may name them as partner is on file. Posts naming VAA stay on hold until then.
recipients_note: Add each organisation's name only after it has agreed to receive (e.g. "Children's Hospital Colorado"). Until one is here, posts say: local children's charities and families in need.
events_note: One entry per drop-off event: { "date": "Sat 14 Nov", "place": "<venue, town>" }. All run 12 to 6 pm per the brief.
counts_note: Each count must come from the team's dated tally (who counted, when). A figure without a source doesn't go in.
